d:
Senegal are officially crowned the AFCON champions again. The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) has overturned the decision that awarded Morocco a 3-0 victory in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, restoring Senegal's 1-0 win.
The controversy began in Rabat, when Senegal's players walked off after a disputed penalty was awarded to Morocco. They returned to the pitch, won in extra time and celebrated the title. But the celebrations did not last. Senegal were later stripped of the trophy.
